title: Issuance of the Northgate Credit Cards Reward Certificate
content:
These program terms govern when the rewards of a Northgate Credit Cards account are issued as the card reward certificate, the annual certificate redeemable at Northgate.

## Issuance clause

The card rewards balance of a reward year is issued as a certificate with the statement closing in the card's certificate issue month of the following year when it is at least the card's smallest issued amount; a smaller balance carries forward. A certificate is issued only on an account whose status is active; where the card's terms hold a certificate while the card is restricted, a certificate due while the card is restricted is issued when the card becomes active again.

## What is issued

- **Value.** The certificate's value is the reward year's whole card rewards balance when that balance is at least the smallest issued amount. When the balance is smaller, no certificate is issued and the balance carries forward into the next year.
- **Effect on the balance.** The amount issued leaves the card rewards balance.
- **One per reward year.** A certificate is issued for each reward year converted, recorded with its issue date and the reward year it converts.
- **Status that decides.** The status of the card account as its own record shows it at the time of issue.

## Issuance decision table

| Reward-year balance against the smallest issued amount | Status of the card account | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| At least the amount | Active | Certificate issued for the whole balance, with the statement closing in the issue month |
| At least the amount | Restricted, on a card whose terms hold the certificate while restricted | Held; issued when the card becomes active again |
| At least the amount | Applied, declined or closed | Not issued (issuance is only on an active account) |
| Smaller than the amount | Any | No certificate; the balance carries forward |

## Boundary cases

- A balance exactly equal to the smallest issued amount is at least that amount and is issued.
- A balance one cent below the smallest issued amount carries forward.
- A certificate due in the issue month on a restricted card whose terms hold the certificate while restricted, and whose restriction is lifted in a later month, is issued when the card becomes active again, not in the issue month.
